title: Session Management Services; Stage 3 (SMF SBI)
tagline: SMF PDU Session — the service that triggers session policy
summary: TS 29.502 defines the Nsmf_PDUSession service on the SMF. It is the Stage-3 SBI for creating and managing PDU sessions, SM contexts, and user-plane resources. In the 29.512 story, SMF runs these procedures first — then calls PCF for session management policy before applying rules to the UPF.
whyItMatters: Without 29.502, there is no SBI contract for how AMF hands a PDU session to SMF or how SMF programs the UPF. The 512 policy call sits inside the PDU session establishment procedure defined in TS 23.502 and implemented here at Stage 3.
